title: Add bounded sampled inspection contracts and authorized ingress
head: 160e22cecdb67a1cdf16105b4e04a3c304fab92a
body:
Adds an additive 48 KiB / 256-point inspection contract and host-authorized, content-addressed intake without changing existing BIM schemas. Capture, units, frame, calibration, provider, policy and feature revisions remain bound; contradictory inputs, path escape, symlinks and digest drift refuse.

Stacked on #232. This increment registers no executable geometry operation and makes no physical or GD&T qualification claim.

Validation: 14 focused tests and a wheel build pass from this increment in isolation. Synthetic fixtures only.

title: Run bounded plane, freight envelope and visible lean through retained NCP operations
head: ae62e651c9080de784fe4bf6823ec4ffa40302b3
body:
Adds fixed sampled-plane least-squares residual, frame-aligned freight envelope/explicit billing-rule rounding, and visible principal-axis lean operations through the existing registry, Session, AgentHost and CLI/stdio MCP lifecycle. Evidence gaps hold decisions; provider-free retained witnesses check exact decision bounds. Attempts reuse retained responses and unknown interrupted outcomes never automatically dispatch again.

Scope is sampled geometry under declared bounded error models. No minimum-zone GD&T, occupied-volume, hidden-integrity, safety or physical qualification claim. PMI preserves one semantic association subset and always requires normative/datum review.

Validation: contract/profile tests and wheel build pass with only this increment and its base. Final stack also exercises real SDK subprocesses and existing BIM/Board/recovery regressions; results accompany the HTTP checkpoint.

title: Bind metrology comparison campaigns and non-executing action drafts
head: 46f4388b11000047450c7f2ae76237b8c1ac6bb6
body:
Binds exact numerical candidate, source cases, calibration and held-out reference identities to the existing full-joint-covariance reference comparator. Reports keep synthetic/recorded declarations separate from physical qualification. Adds create-only local campaign/draft commands and stale-bound review, remeasurement and quarantine proposals with mandatory approval and no integration calls.

Synthetic campaigns remain blocked; recorded evidence still needs independent physical review and source authentication. This does not close the physical BIM campaign or establish normative GD&T conformance.

Validation: contract/profile/review tests and wheel build pass with this increment and its bases. Tests reject misbound candidates/references, resealed numerical/authority tampering and stale proposals; retained review runs with solvers disabled.

title: Serve isolated metrology investigations over authenticated Streamable HTTP
head: 87f15add70d96621062520b285d33c738719fca5
body:
Adds a bounded MCP 2.3.0 Streamable HTTP adapter over the existing sampled-profile operations. Host-owned bearer bindings isolate investigations, freeze profile/grants, bound requests/jobs, deny arbitrary paths/URLs/selectors, and support per-request revocation. Real SDK stdio/HTTP tests cover retained reads, cross-tenant denial, malformed/oversized requests, changed profiles, retries and explicit restart.

Validation: 479 selected source regressions, 74 final focused metrology tests, 473 isolated installed-wheel regressions, 9 exact historical BIM/CSE interoperability tests and 12 native scan-likelihood fixtures pass with no skips. Counts overlap. Each preceding increment independently passes its focused tests and wheel build. All 700 final packaged files match source/wheel/installed bytes. Detailed hashes and compressed JUnit evidence: validation/metrology/2026-10-17-software/.

This is an internal loopback pilot candidate with pre-shared bearer provisioning, not a deployed hosted service or an OAuth authorization server. Physical BIM/manufacturing/freight/lean evidence, normative GD&T control review, and managed remote TLS/identity/deployment qualification remain open. No automatic physical release, ledger update or operational action execution. See docs/METROLOGY_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md for task-by-task limits.

Stacked on #238 → #237 → #236 → #232. Keep the stack in order for review; no merges performed.

title: Define extended work order for operational engineering investigations through MCP
head: ee33170fbfca8022602468637073901d61ea5b22
body:
Specifies the requested connection between operational records and engineering/design/analysis/research work, with personal MCP access through the existing NCP substrate. The four engineering questions drive five complete journeys, twelve implementation packages and twenty acceptance scenarios.

The source inventory identifies existing measurement MCP, retained Link journals/history checks, acquired/calibrated windows, residual/observability monitoring, reference comparisons, Board investigations and read-only GPU telemetry. Scope stays tied to the requested capability; this is not a mandate to build a general-purpose SCADA platform.

Includes identity and uncertainty contracts, configuration applicability, acquisition continuity and historical projections, model support findings, stale-bound next-test proposals, CLI/MCP/UI consistency, restart/revocation/isolation behavior, packaging and complete end-to-end closeout requirements. Physical/deployment evidence is separated from implementable software work.

Documentation only: one new Markdown file. All sixteen repository references were checked against pinned main 62577c96a280287c5df5d54783be00df1ab7c0de; work-package/journey/scenario identifiers and whitespace checks pass. Implementation tasks are proposed and acceptance scenarios are NOT RUN for this work order. Existing code, metrology plans and qualification records are unchanged.

title: Add seven built-in numerical operations through NCP and MCP
head: c47a8621cd97f8d46afe526ed15534111fc6e347
body:
## Summary

Integrates seven bounded supplied-model operations into the existing built-in NCP/NET operation, capability, semantic planning, retained Session and MCP execution paths:

- `uncertainty.propagate.v1`, `uncertainty.budget.v1`
- `calibration.fit.v1`, `calibration.residuals.v1`
- `sensitivity.local.v1`, `observability.rank.v1`, `model.discrepancy.v1`

Includes strict numerical/covariance contracts, source-committed runtime identity, provider-free saved-result validation, synthetic examples and an operating guide. Existing profile execution permissions are not widened. Uses existing MCP tools; no parallel execution endpoint or new dependency for core calculations.

Based on repaired main `62577c96`; the separate consolidation repairs are preserved unchanged.

## Verification

- Test-first analytical/Decimal and independent GLS references, correlated covariance, negative cross contributions, singular cases, scale invariance, refusal, runtime tamper, saved read and fresh replay tests.
- **556 focused source tests passed on the final repaired-main integration**, including all numerical, runner, catalogue, control-plane, semantic, MCP, covariance, polymer, production and spatial-request cases.
- 72 dedicated tests passed against the noneditable wheel built on repaired main, with isolated interpreter imports from `site-packages`; includes real modern MCP execution and legacy resume, admission, idempotent retry and artifact schema validation.
- Clean retained-source audit passed for all 21 imported modules; four source-ancestry/runtime and installed-launcher tests passed.
- CI policy audit passed; 18 policy tests and 46 subtests passed.
- Added Linux/Windows source-and-installed-wheel CI job with no skipped cases allowed.
- Retained reports and hashes: [`validation/numerical-builtins/summary.json`](validation/numerical-builtins/summary.json). Counts overlap and should not be summed.
- Exploratory repository-wide sweep: 506 modules attempted, 12 hit the 180-second module limit, 1,169 skipped cases. Three old two-operation catalogue expectations were corrected and are included in the final 556-pass run. This sweep began on the pre-repair development worktree and is **not** final repository-wide qualification. An intermediate dirty-tree provenance run was discarded; the clean source audit and focused reruns supersede it.
- Full hosted regression and Windows execution remain pending. No claim that every repository/provider gate is green.

## Limits

These v1 operations compute declared models, not physical qualification. Exact-x affine calibration only; supplied Jacobians only; caller-declared covariance/scales/frames/independence. No hardware acquisition, remote deployment, implied acceptance thresholds or widening of operator grants. Offline saved validation is structural plus selected algebraic checks, not rerunning a provider or certifying a fitted model.

See `docs/NUMERICAL_BUILTINS.md` and `examples/numerical_operations/prepare.py` for exact contracts and MCP setup.

title: Add bounded BIM clearance inspections through retained execution and local MCP
head: 585bfcca43122227e4355e473c9c7fa9742de2da
body:
Implements the first bounded metrology increment: one BIM clearance inspection through NCP's existing CapabilityRegistry, OperationRegistry, runner, Session, AgentHost and local MCP transport. No new geometry engine or execution ledger.

- Retain exact bounded inspection/model bytes, scan points, separate scan/model frames, calibration and covariance declarations, model/requirement revisions and a target element.
- Reuse the unchanged CSE scan-likelihood provider, pinned to native tree `f91c982b580ad4f16a27ea149eedf0e338f6d764`. Registration supports association; independent pose supplies measurement positioning. Existing coverage, pose, innovation and invariant gates remain in force.
- Retain held/unresolved outcomes, uncertainty components and modeled risk decisions. Offline readers check bindings, uncertainty arithmetic and decision consistency without claiming independent geometry verification.
- CLI prepare/run/inspect and actual local MCP use the same operation. Host-only provider paths, fixed graph, no editable numerical policy; restart, identical-attempt retry and fresh replay use existing recovery.
- Add docs, two explicitly synthetic fixtures, candidate CI and a reconstructed 12-task roadmap. The earlier local planning files were unavailable; these files do not purport to reproduce unseen contents.

Validation:
- **323 installed tests passed**, zero failures/skips: 51 profile cases plus 272 adjacent checks. Earlier source run: 319 passes before four final analytic reference cases; counts overlap and are not additive.
- **21 existing native clearance tests + 3 subtests passed.**
- **693 package files** match source, wheel and installed bytes. Wheel SHA-256: `62b25a747f481fcbaaf0e93657abd431d6af3e1d31c790db5797f3e85ac03e81`.
- Separate installed CLI prepare → run → offline inspect passed. Real installed stdio MCP initialize → list → execute → identical retry passed.
- Linux/Python 3.12.14/NumPy 2.4.3; fresh noneditable venv with explicitly shared host third-party dependencies. Lint and staged whitespace checks pass.
- Tight synthetic pose declaration is held for pose disagreement. Deliberately large pose uncertainty completes with **UNRESOLVED**. No provider success mocks in these journeys.

Published commit `029444131ce5abb7793b7b50f94efbb21242e693`, tree `cc9f1333246e6ae481baa2494bf4474762c4b721`, on main `8a6beb844a4a3c3944637b1e3f386d48d28507d0`. All 12 uploaded files match prepared/tested bytes. Only existing code edit is additive host selection in agent_mcp.py. The newer operator-console merge is preserved.

Limits: no physical campaign, calibration authenticity, independent geometry qualification, manufacturing/GD&T or freight implementation, hosted Board/remote MCP qualification or actuation authority. No canonical state admission. Hosted checks are pending, not counted as local evidence. Ten unrelated binary/data/vendor artifacts were unavailable or stale in the local reconstruction; this is not a full-monorepo regression. See validation/metrology-clearance/summary.json and docs/METROLOGY_CLEARANCE.md.

**Draft for review; no merge or deployment.**
